---
title: "Geodynamics"
---

This is the website for the Geodynamics course at the University of Helsinki.

## Course topics

This course introduces Geodynamics through a series of lessons and exercises that can be found on the left side of this page. Course topics include:

- Earth's structure and plate tectonics
- Continuum mechanics
- Elasticity and flexure of the lithosphere
- Friction and earthquakes
- Viscous flow and plasticity
- Lithospheric strength profiles
- Heat transfer and convection
- Tectonic plate driving forces
